item.title: PAGASA Daily Weather - 4:00 AM, 24 October 2026
item.description:
[SYNOPSIS]
At 3:00 AM today, the center of the eye of Typhoon "ROSAL" {CHAMPI} was estimated based on all available data at 415 km North of Itbayat, Batanes (24.5°N, 122.5°E) with maximum sustained winds of 150 km/h near the center and gustiness of up to 185 km/h. It is moving Southwestward at 10 km/h. Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) affecting Palawan, Visayas and Mindanao.
[FORECAST WEATHER CONDITIONS]
1. PLACE: Batanes
WEATHER CONDITION: Rains with gusty winds
CAUSED BY: TC ROSAL
IMPACTS: Possible flash floods or landslides due to moderate to at times heavy rains. Minimal to minor threat to life and property due to strong winds.
